author: MrCritico
body: How do you get them? I’m level 65 and I don’t have any

author: Lord_Frieza_of_Orna
body: Am I the only one who gets at least 5 gauntlet keys every boss gauntlet run? Even if i don't get 5 keys, I'll get close and get another key from a world boss nearby or raid boss kill to make up for it. I use my keys all the time on boss gauntlets and I can't run out.

author: Cainiac87
body: You start really getting them in T8 boss gauntlets. I started t9 with about 950 and only got down to 650 by t10. Now I'm over 1100

author: Cllydoscope
body: I hit 200 with 300 keys and never dropped below 260. World bosses are great for keys, and if you are buffing with rod, and actually clearing boss dungeons, you should break even or lose one or two keys per dungeon.

author: Troy69851
body: T9 doesnt eat keys if you kill world bosses i currently have 1200 level 214 700 gauntlets completed.. So dont worry about it.

author: Jaruden
body: I hit 200 with 615 and now have 675 @ 207.  As long as you're not dying in boss gauntlets, you should do just fine.
